title: Quick-Sketch Portrait Tools
content: This set of water-soluble colored pencils and water brushes is all you need for sketching people in the wild.You can order Caran d'Ache Supracolor 11 pencils individually atDick Blick. The colors shown here are:035 Ochre037 Brown Ochre045 Vandycke Brown063 English Red159 Brown009 Black407 Sepia155 Blue JeansThe four waterbrushes are medium or large size rounds, made by Niji, which you can getfrom AmazonThey're filled with 1. Water, 2.Higgins Eternal Ink, 3.Higgins Sepia Ink, and 4.Sheaffer Skrip blue inkThese inks are non-waterproof, which allows them to be dissolved after they are dry, and they protect the life and flow of your waterbrush.It also helps to have a kneaded eraser and a pencil sharpener that will catch the shavings. The sketchbook should be something that can take water media, such as aMoleskine watercolor journal
